notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 alternate time-advance surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available delivery paths, backward-time rejection boundaries, timestamped reflection, and grant servicing without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador alternate time-advance services with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection, flush-queue, and time-advance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador alternate-advance declarations
